verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an integrated ledger tying money movement and balances to transactions (docs-3, docs-19), real-time authorization-to-clearing via collaborative authorization and spend rules (docs-7, docs-8), and daily reconciliation/settlement handled by in-house ops teams (docs-23, docs-44). However, evidence lacks concrete finance-lead-facing reporting/reconciliation UI details, penny-level settlement report specifics, or independent corroboration that reconciliation actually ties out. Missing for 10: dedicated settlement/reconciliation report examples or dashboard screenshots, explicit authorization-to-clearing linkage documentation, and independent/hands-on verification of reconciliation accuracy.
